about: lora_commute (2026-10-19): fine-tune the emoticon -> `o` behaviour as a LoRA on h.2.mlp.down_proj and commute it past the released decomposition with the maps on hand (Euclidean lift of the finished delta-W; pull-back = training the subcomponents, here confined to the LoRA's matrix and rank), beside the full-weight fine-tune under the same maps. The user's question: is a LoRA update easier to decompose than a normal fine-tuning update (instinct: yes). Plan reports/2026-10-19_plan_lora-lift-and-pullback.md plus its addendum. Filed before any arm was trained.

blind_to.Pile PGD ratio: a trigger-specific attack (the adversary is shared over 65k Pile positions holding ~3 triggers; cover: round 2's calibration, the W0 floor); the task-local adversary has no power (review above)
blind_to.controls: G2 for the lift (the state must be the LoRA's model exactly), the lr rule for the pull-back (it must learn), the W0 seeds for the PGD floor, the reproduction gates G4 for the harness
blind_to.d, r, e_delta: everything away from the trigger (cover: the LoRA's kl_other and the Pile ratios)
blind_to.moved: changes spread below 1% (the identity test's regime)

gates.rule: m = max(0.1, 3 x max |Delta d|, |Delta r| between seeds 0 and 1 of pb_8 (step 30) and lift_8 (scored step)); f = PGD floor as above

gates.if_fail: the arm is reported, not scored; its failure is a result
gates.rule: every LoRA_r reaches P(o) >= 0.9 at some checkpoint; every pb_r finds an lr by the rule

gates.if_fail: the lift or the Delta bookkeeping is wrong; stop
gates.reported_beside: P(o) of the lifted components alone (U1; round 2's liftable part gave 0.954 vs 0.999 for LoRA_8 step 10)
gates.rule: for every lift: |P(o) of the lifted state's target model - the fine-tune's held-out P(o)| <= 1e-3 and |sum of shares - 1| <= 1e-6

gates.if_fail: find the cause before the analysis
gates.rule: nothing_ft and lift_ft Pile PGD ratios at step 10 within 25% of 2.18 and 5.41 (round 2); pb_all d and r at step 10 within 0.05 of 0.025 and 0.53 (ladder); nothing LoRA_8 r at step 10 within 0.05 of 0.54 (recruit)

measurements.S_on: recruit.switched at 0.3: alive subcomponents whose mean trigger gate rises by > 0.3; Jaccard with the ft do-nothing arm's set (and with the recruit test's ft_s0 file if present)
measurements.inexpressible: lift.weighted_fractions with Sigma = E[a a^T] of the matrix's input over the train windows: the share of the update's output energy no first-order change of the alive subcomponents can express; per matrix for the LoRA, pooled by energy over the non-saturated matrices for ft
measurements.local: local_faith.local_faithfulness: reported only (its adversaries saturate; reports/2026-10-19_review_pgd-local.md)
measurements.moved: subcomponents whose rank-1 matrix changes by more than 1% of its norm (identity.change_stats); the top 20 by ||Delta(u v^T)|| for P5
measurements.pgd_floor: f = max/min - 1 of the W0 PGD KL over the 3 adversary seeds; 'within 3 floors' = ratio <= 1 + 3 f
measurements.pile: faithfulness.pile_faithfulness (2 blocks of 128 val rows 0..255, one adversary per block, 20 steps of 0.1; stochastic, PGD, CI-masked, unmasked KL with Delta in/out as in rounds 1-3); ratio = arm / W0 seed 0
measurements.routes: local_faith.route_split on the held-out windows: d, r, i, e_gate, e_delta (sum to 1), gain in nats; P(o) of the target (T1) and of the components alone unmasked (U1)

predictions.reported: the step-100 lift against the same thresholds; if d differs from the scored step by more than m, said beside A's cosine with its initialisation

predictions.arm: lift_r at scored steps, r = 1 vs 32
predictions.expected_inexpressible: round 2 found 0.40 (r1 step 30), 0.41 (r8 step 10), 0.30 (r8 step 100) against a null of 0.42 on this matrix: the LoRA's read side is near its random init
predictions.pass: d(lift_1) - d(lift_32) > m and inexpressible(32) > inexpressible(1)

predictions.arm: lift_r at scored steps, Pile PGD ratio
predictions.note: the plan filed this on the task-local pgd_trigger ratio; that adversary saturates at W0 (review 2026-10-19), so the Pile adversary that found round 2's fragility is used instead
predictions.null: all of lift_1, lift_4, lift_8, lift_32 <= 1 + 3 f
predictions.pass: lift_8 and lift_32 >= 1.5 and lift_1 <= 1 + 3 f

predictions.arm: pb_r at step 30, every rank that learns

predictions.pass: >= 8 of the top 20 by ||Delta(u v^T)|| shared

predictions.arm: Pile PGD ratio, lift_8 vs lift_ft (step 10)

reported_not_scored: every arm's full route split, task-local harness, retained shares, moved counts, S_on sizes and Jaccards; the LoRA's cosine with its initialisation per checkpoint; the realised rank of every pull-back's delta-W; pb_r at step 10; the lr sweeps; Pile ratios of pb_r, pb_full and the do-nothing arms

setup.LoRA_r: rank r in (1, 4, 8, 32) on h.2.mlp.down_proj, Adam lr 0.001, arm A's loss, batch 32, clip 1, 100 steps, checkpoints (10, 30, 100). Scored step = the first checkpoint with held-out P(o) >= 0.9 (rank 1 reaches 0.22 at step 10 and 0.99 at step 30 in round 2); the step-100 state is the finished LoRA, reported against the same thresholds. Measured do-nothing (delta-W in Delta) and lifted
setup.W0: the released decomposition under round 2's Pile harness with adversary seeds (0, 1, 2)
setup.ft: full-weight fine-tune, arm A recipe (Adam lr 3e-05, all 24 matrices, seed 0), checkpoints (10, 100); do-nothing and lifted on all 24 matrices (round 2's lift). Step 10 is the matched step
setup.lift: lift.lift_state: Euclidean (minimum-norm) lift of the matrix's delta-W onto its alive subcomponents, tol 1e-6; target weights W0 + delta-W, so Delta moves by O(delta-W) - dU dV^T
setup.pb_all: free offsets on all 24 matrices, lr 1e-05 fixed (the ladder's emoticon arm), 30 steps
setup.pb_full: the same with free offsets on every alive subcomponent of h.2.mlp.down_proj
setup.pb_r: pullback.train on h.2.mlp.down_proj only with rank-r offsets dU = P S^T, dV = Q T^T (weight change rank <= 2r), Adam, 30 steps, lr the smallest in (1e-05, 3e-05, 0.0001, 0.0003, 0.001) with held-out P(o) >= 0.9 and kl_other <= 0.11 at the last step (amendment 1's rule); none passing = did not learn (reported at the lr with the highest P(o))
setup.seeds: LoRA_8 and pb_8 (at the lr selected for seed 0) repeated with optimiser/init seed 1
setup.windows: round 1's emoticon windows (365 train, 73 held-out, trigger at index 20, target token `o`)
